title: Jan pachani yatiñanak churir jaqi
intro: Mä jachʼañchat jaqejja, wali amuytʼasirïtapata ukat wali yatiñan ewjjtʼanakapat uñtʼatawa, nayrajj walja maranakat sipansa jukʼamp ewjjtʼanak churäna. Qullan qillqatanakan qillqtʼat arunakapax sapa mayniruw yuspärañataki, paciencianïñataki ukat chiqapar sarnaqañataki irpki.
clues: Yatiñ kankañampiw bendicitäna, janiw profetjam bendicitäkti.
Nayax wawajarux jach’a juchanakat iwxt’awayta: Allah ukamp chikt’atäña.
Nayax lurawinakan pesajepat yatichawayta, mä mostaza jathax wali askiwa, ukat kunjams Allah jupax uñstayani.
Allah-ar ukat maynin awk taykapar yuspärañwa jukʼamp chʼamañchtʼta, mä wawar uywañan chʼamachasitanakap uñtʼasa.
Nayan ewjjtʼanakajajj akanakawa: oracionan uttʼayasiña, askinak mayiña, jan walinak jarkʼaña ukat kunatï maynir paski ukanak pacienciampi aguantaña.
Quran qillqatan mä jaljapax nayat sutimp uñt’atawa, ukanx yatichäwinakaja ukat yatichäwinak uñt’ayawaykta ukanakaw utji.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
